s: shoo; a sound made to chase off an animal
Ksch! Ksch! Weg da, du blöde Möwe!
Shoo! Shoo! Go away, you stupid seagull!
ksch.et: Probably imitative, compare Russian кыш (kyš). Alternatively from kusch (command for a dog to lie down). The form kusch also appears in the sense of “shoo”, but this might be through secondary confluence.
